### Spokesmen for God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/spokesmen-god
Passage: Exodus 7:1-7
Points:
- While many assume prophets primarily foretold the future, their primary task was to serve as spokesmen declaring God's Word.
- The dynamic between God, Moses, and Aaron provides a foundational picture of what prophetic ministry entails.
- Moses stood in the place of God toward Pharaoh, while Aaron acted as the prophet delivering the message of repentance and release.
- Though the special office of Old Testament prophet ceased with Christ, pastors still speak for God whenever they faithfully proclaim Scripture.

### Quiet Walk - Feb. 1
Author: Walk Thru the Bible
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/quiet-walk/quiet-walk-feb-1-1126372.html
Passage: Exodus 7:1
Points:
- The Lord assigned Moses to stand in the place of God before Pharaoh.
- In a similar way, believers often serve as God's representatives before an watching world.
- To many people who do not read Scripture, Christians are the only visible representation of Jesus they will see.
- Believers are urged to pursue Christlikeness so their actions faithfully point others toward God.
